highlights: Update your joined servers to this version too: you can then restart a self-hosted server from the app and set its agent defaults and thread limits.
Choose which agents can use each Vault item. An API key saved for one agent now stays in the encrypted Vault.
Make pictures and short videos in Workflows with GPT Image, Grok Imagine and Sunra models.
Connect Sunra and TryPost from the Apps marketplace.
OpenBot opens faster when chats are long, and on Windows and Linux it asks before it quits while agents work.
